 Crm-M-683
 Date of D
 Manish Singla ...Petiti
 Versus
 State of Punjab ...Respon
 Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anoop Chitkara

Present: Mr. Pushp Jain, Advocate
 for the petitioner.

** **
 Anoop Chitkara, J.
Fir No. Dated Offences Police Station 247 04.12.2020 420, 465, 467, 468, 471, Division No.2,
Pathankot 120-B Ipc
1.

Seeking transfer of trial in the FIR captioned above, the petitioner has come up before this Court under Section 447 r/w 528 BNSS, 2023.
2.

The limited question for which the petitioner has come up before this Court is that he was the victim-informant and the accused Vishal Handa was declared as proclaimed offender and despite that, he was not arrested and is roaming freely in the area, as such petitioner wants the case to be transferred from District Pathankot to competent Court at District Mansa.
3. This cannot be a ground to transfer the case, however the concerned Superintendent of Police of District Pathankot is directed to look into the allegations of the petitioner.
4. Given above, the present petition is disposed of.
All pending applications, if any, stand disposed of.
